case: hex() computed results through typed CSV restore
contract: The fixture applies hex() to integer, real, UTF-8 text, empty text, BLOB, SQL NULL, formula-shaped text and the SQLite ANY CSV tag-shaped text.
The native typeof() oracle confirms every hex() result is TEXT; SQLite returns empty text for both empty text and SQL NULL inputs, and the query metadata remains the driver's NULL fallback.
Typed CSV import into another STRICT ANY table preserves all hex output strings as native TEXT, including the empty results, with their row identities intact.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::sqlite_any_contract::sqlite_hex_any_csv_round_trip_keeps_hex_results_as_text -- --exact --test-threads=1

sqlite_any_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib sqlite_any_contract -- --test-threads=1
